description: This file defines the abstract class em_orch_t, which provides an interface for orchestrating commands within an em (execution manager) context. It includes method declarations for handling commands, states, statistics, and virtual functions for building candidates, pre-processing, and state checks, indicating it is meant to be subclassed for specific implementations.

classes.name: em_orch_t
classes.description: An abstract class defining the orchestration interface for command management within the em context, including lifecycle, state handling, statistics, and command processing functionalities.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state based on the provided command.

methods.name: handle_timeout
methods.description: Handles the timeout event.

methods.name: submit_commands
methods.description: Submits an array of commands for processing.

methods.name: build_candidates
methods.description: Pure virtual: constructs a set of candidates based on a command.

methods.name: eligible_for_active
methods.description: Checks if a command is eligible to be considered active.

methods.name: pre_process_orch_op
methods.description: Pure virtual: pre-processes the orchestration operation.

methods.name: pre_process_cancel
methods.description: Pure virtual: handles pre-processing for command cancellation.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_exec
methods.description: Pure virtual: checks if EM is ready for orchestration execution.

methods.name: is_em_ready_for_orch_fini
methods.description: Pure virtual: checks if EM is ready for orchestration finalization.

methods.name: orch_transient
methods.description: Pure virtual: manages transient orchestration states.

methods.name: submit_command
methods.description: Submits a single command.

methods.name: destroy_command
methods.description: Destroys a command object.

methods.name: cancel_command
methods.description: Cancels a command of a specified type.

methods.name: push_stats
methods.description: Updates command with statistics.

methods.name: pop_stats
methods.description: Extracts and processes statistics from a command.

methods.name: update_stats
methods.description: Updates internal statistics based on command.

methods.name: is_cmd_type_in_progress
methods.description: Checks if a command type is currently in progress.

methods.name: get_dev_test_status
methods.description: Checks device test command status.

methods.name: is_cmd_type_renew_in_progress
methods.description: Checks if dev test command renew is in progress.

methods.name: orchestrate
methods.description: Executes command orchestration within the em context.
